turns.text: Hello, I received a print last week but the colors do not match my room. I would like to return it.
I'm sorry the colors don't suit your room. I can help with a return. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email address used for the order.
My order is SC-4060 and the email used is liam.fletcher.v2@example.com. Please file the return request.

I've filed your return request (R-1) for order SC-4060. Staff must approve it. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and you pay the return postage. Staff must also approve any refund.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Separate question. How many working days does print production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

turns.text: Revin la printul meu. Cine plateste transportul pentru retur?
Clientul plătește transportul retur. Cererea ta de retur (R-1) așteaptă aprobarea echipei, iar rambursarea trebuie și ea aprobată de echipă.
I still want to return order SC-4060. I can cover the return shipping.

Thanks. Your return request (R-1) for order SC-4060 is already filed, so I don't need to file it again. Staff must approve it, and you pay the return shipping, as you've agreed. Staff must also approve any refund.

Am notat: o frunză pe încheietură, de circa 4 cm, sâmbătă dimineața. Un coleg preia discuția și te va contacta. Eu nu pot confirma programarea, prețul sau data.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a tattoo: a leaf on the wrist, about 4 cm. Available Saturday morning. No price or date given. Customer is verified (SC-4060, liam.fletcher.v2@example.com); return request R-1 is pending separately.
